title: Jacobs: the abduction program aims at planetary takeover by stealth

tellings.quote: Well, David Jacobs said that the endgame of the abduction program was planetary acquisition by stealth.

plain: David Jacobs, a researcher of alien abduction reports, is said to have concluded that the endgame of the abductions is the quiet takeover of the planet, which he called planetary acquisition by stealth. Tim Alberino, a guest who also describes things he says he has witnessed, sums up Jacobs's view without naming a source beyond a book called Walking Among Us. If true, the abductions would be part of a plan to take over the Earth.
